g.\n* **Run insights** — an AI-written diff against your previous completed run: which cases moved, which tools changed behavior,
which models diverged. Skim this first; it usually points at the right rabbit hole. The model pass is **included with MCPJam and c
onsumes no credits**; it counts against a daily insight quota shared with swarm wave and user-testing insights. Guests browsing wi
thout a signed-in account will see a **Sign in** prompt in the insights band — signing in unlocks the feature without losing your
place.\n* **Overview tab** — every run with its summary metrics, plus a Suite Health chart whose bars link to individual run rows.
Click in for the iteration-level breakdown. The table shows **Date** first, then **Run**, with separate **Client**, **Model**, **
Platform**, **Commit**, **Rate**, **Latency**, **Tokens**, and **Calls** columns. The Client column counts unique clients; when th
ere are more than two, a **+N** badge appears — hover it to see all clients in a tooltip.\n* **Cases tab** — every case with its l
atest verdict and a quick replay button. To delete a case, hover its row and click the trash icon; a confirmation dialog appears b
efore the case is removed. The trash icon is hidden for CI-managed suites and read-only configurations. You can also delete the op
en case from the case editor header using the same trash icon — it is hidden for unsaved drafts.\n* **Executions tab** — a flat, f
ilterable list of every individual test execution across all cases, sorted most-recent-first. Each row shows the case name, result

(passed/failed/pending/cancelled), and timestamp. Click any row to open it in the compare view.
--

When two or more host conf
igurations are attached to a suite, a **By case / By host** toggle appears. **By host** shows a matrix — one column per host, one
row per case. Each cell shows pass/fail dots, pass rate, median latency, and token usage. A host detached after runs were recorded

stays visible, labelled **historical**.

### Cost

Every iteration carries the MCPJam-billed cost of the model work it did,
